text: failures. My home is the sky. I am spirit and ether. There's nothing you cannot see within my autumn celia, within the white fibers I leave curling upon your uniform. And my wet eyes are the glasses you wear to see more clearly. When I spin, the room spins with me, and in the stirring nothing is left behind. The void left in the wake of my thrashings is a charred, coiled turd,
